1.w: [“] I have spoken these things to you⁺ so that you⁺ should not fall away.

2.w: They will put you⁺ out of the synagogues; but an hour is coming that everyone having killed you⁺ will think he is offering a service to God.

3.w: And they will do these things because they do not know the Father nor Me.

4.w: But I have said these things to you⁺ so that when their hour might have come, you⁺ may remember that I said them to you⁺. Now I did not say these things to you⁺ from the beginning, because I was with you⁺.

5.w: But now I am going away to the One having sent Me, and none of you⁺ asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’

6.w: But because I have said these things to you⁺, sorrow has filled your⁺ heart.

7.w: But I say to you⁺ the truth, it is profitable for you⁺ that I should go away. For unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you⁺; but if I go, I will send Him to you⁺.

8.w: And having come, He will convict the world concerning sin and concerning righteousness and concerning judgment:

9.w: concerning sin indeed, because they do not believe in Me;

10.w: and concerning righteousness, because I am going away to the Father and you⁺ see Me no longer;

11.w: and concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

12.w: I still have many things to say to you⁺, but you⁺ are not able to bear [them] now.

13.w: But when He, the Spirit of truth, shall come, He will guide you⁺ into all the truth. For He will not speak from Himself, but whatever He may hear, He will speak. And He will declare to you⁺ the things coming.

14.w: He will glorify Me, for He will take from that which [is] Mine and will declare [it] to you⁺.

15.w: All things, as many as the Father has, are Mine. Because of this, I said that He will take from that which [is] Mine and will declare [it] to you⁺.

16.w: A little while and you⁺ see Me no longer; and again a little while and you⁺ will look on Me.”

17.w: Therefore some of His disciples said to one another, “What is this that He says to us, ‘A little while and you⁺ do not see Me; and again a little while and you⁺ will look on Me,’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”

18.w: Therefore they were saying, “What is this that He says, ‘A little while’? We do not know what He is saying.”

19.w: Jesus knew that they were wanting to ask Him, and He said to them, “Do you⁺ inquire among one another concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while and you⁺ do not see Me, and again a little while and you⁺ will look on Me’?

20.w: Truly, truly, I say to you⁺ that you⁺ will weep and will lament, but the world will rejoice. You⁺ will be grieved, but your⁺ grief will turn to joy.

21.w: The woman has pain when she is giving birth, because her hour has come; but when she brings forth the child, she remembers the tribulation no longer, because of the joy that a man has been born into the world.

22.w: Therefore you⁺ also indeed have grief now; but I will see you⁺ again, and your⁺ heart will rejoice, and no one will take your⁺ joy from you⁺.

23.w: And in that day you⁺ will ask of Me nothing. Truly, truly, I say to you⁺, whatever you⁺ may ask the Father in My name, He will give you⁺.

24.w: Until now you⁺ have asked nothing in My name. Ask and you⁺ will receive, so that your⁺ joy may be full.

25.w: I have spoken these things to you⁺ in allegories; an hour is coming when I will speak to you⁺ no more in allegories, but I will report to you⁺ plainly concerning the Father.

26.w: In that day you⁺ will ask in My name, and I do not say to you⁺ that I will implore the Father for you⁺.

27.w: For the Father Himself loves you⁺, because you⁺ have loved Me and have believed that I came forth from God.

28.w: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world; again I leave the world and go to the Father.”

29.w: His disciples say, “Behold, now You speak in openness, and You do not speak allegory.

30.w: Now we know that You know all things and have no need that anyone should ask You. In this we believe that You came forth from God.”

31.w: Jesus answered them, “Now do you⁺ believe?

32.w: Behold, an hour is coming and has come when you⁺ shall be scattered, each to [his] own, and Me you⁺ shall leave alone. Yet I am not alone, for the Father is with Me.

33.w: I have spoken these things to you⁺ so that in Me you⁺ may have peace. In the world you⁺ have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
